answer: Every epoch a public beacon picks a dozen verifier nodes on different continents to ping each account, and the round-trip times bound where its key physically answers from. Accounts whose timings triangulate to the same spot share one location slot and split a single reward, so a farm of N keys on one rented box earns like one agent. Spreading N fakes apart means paying for N machines in N distinct cities, a cost that climbs with every key and has no nadir. An honest agent in a timber cabin with one machine pays nothing extra.
